description: Complete redesign of the Wallet Console (apps/wallet-console) with the same quality treatment as merchant console: @counter/ui components, Auth0 integration, dark/light mode, collapsible sidebar, command palette, toast notifications, loading/error/empty states, settings, profile. Wire to counter-agent-runtime.fly.dev APIs.
steps: Update apps/wallet-console/package.json: add dependencies @counter/ui, @auth0/nextjs-auth0, framer-motion, next-themes, sonner, cmdk, lucide-react, tailwindcss, @tailwindcss/postcss, postcss
Create apps/wallet-console/src/app/globals.css importing Tailwind and @counter/ui brand styles
Create apps/wallet-console/src/lib/auth.ts - Auth0 configuration (same Auth0 tenant as merchant console)
Create apps/wallet-console/src/middleware.ts - Auth0 middleware protecting routes
Rewrite apps/wallet-console/src/app/layout.tsx - Full redesign with ThemeProvider, Toaster, collapsible Sidebar
Create apps/wallet-console/src/components/app-sidebar.tsx - Wallet-specific sidebar with wallet status indicator
Create apps/wallet-console/src/components/top-bar.tsx - Top bar matching merchant console pattern
Rewrite apps/wallet-console/src/app/page.tsx - Dashboard with wallet status overview
Rewrite all route pages with @counter/ui components
acceptance_criteria: Wallet console builds successfully with next build
All existing routes render with new UI (no regressions)
Sidebar navigation covers all wallet sections
Dark mode default with working light mode toggle
Auth0 integration set up with route handlers
Command palette works with wallet-specific actions
No TypeScript errors in build output
verification: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && cd /root/counterX && pnpm install && pnpm build
findings: fs_write tool did not persist to disk; used bash heredocs. Badge component uses error not destructive variant. middleware.ts deprecated warning in Next.js 16 but still works. Import paths use @/ path alias not relative .js imports.
